name: rsp-ops
description: rsplugins session operations: idle autocompact for the sdd-loop conductor (ported from rs-sdk's rs-ops).

autocompact.title: Autocompact
autocompact.description: Idle auto-compaction in rsplugins sessions (user settings): on = an idle conductor over 25% plus a cancellable failsafe for any idle session at 75%; conductor-only = the conductor rule alone; off = never. /rsp-autocompact on|off overrides it for one session.
